## 3d. Ali Shuffle

## Procedure

1. Stand with one foot on either side of a line on a field or court (toes of the right foot to the line and the heel of the left foot to the line) (-32)
2. Moving laterally down the line, switch feet while jumping in the air (the right foot will now be on the far side of the line with the heel nearest the line, and the left foot will now be on the near side with toes to the line)

## Coaching Points

- Stay low to the ground while jumping
- Keep head up with eyes focused straight ahead
- Shuffle to the right and then to the left
